name: Kaiketsu! Osabakiina
source:
Osabakiina is a character from Japanese radio drama. You play as a newbie manager whose goal is to make Osabakina into a big idol. Game features interactive dialogue sequences where selection determines further development. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]

A short visual novel produced by voice actress Nana Mizuki.
translation:
大咲伊娜是日本广播剧中的人物。你扮演一名新手经理，目标是让奥萨巴金娜成为大偶像。游戏具有互动对话序列，其中的选择决定进一步的发展。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]

由声优水树奈奈制作的短篇视觉小说。
